DESIGN & BUILD, DELIVERED IN-HOUSE
Interior design, fit-out, joinery, renovation, landscape and project management — under one team.
The Studio

SPACE IS NEVER
JUST SPACE.

OPRELL Interiors is a Dubai-based design & build practice, established in 2020. We design, produce and deliver interiors entirely in-house — one team responsible from the first sketch to the final handover.

Our capability is end-to-end: interior design, fit-out, custom joinery, landscape and pools, and project management — delivered by a 165-strong workforce certified to ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001, operating from our own drawing office and joinery workshop.

From villas and apartments to offices, clinics and F&B spaces, every project runs on a single contract and a single programme — with the same supervisors and trades on site from day one to handover.

What sets us apart is accountability. One team owns the full scope — no handoffs, no diluted responsibility — which is why our work is documented, photographed and delivered on time, and why our clients come back.

One studio. One standard. Proven delivery.

OPRELL Interiors

About OPRELL
Our Process

From first sketch to handover

Six stages, one team — the same people who design your space are the ones who build it.

01

Concept

Brief, site survey and feasibility — we listen first, then shape the direction with moodboards, spatial studies and budget clarity.

Week 1brief & survey
02

Design

Layouts, 3D visuals, material palettes and working drawings — every detail resolved before a single trade touches the site.

3Dvisualised before build
03

Approvals

Authority approvals, permits and a locked BOQ — programme and budget fixed before works start, so there are no surprises mid-build.

Fixedprogramme & budget
04

Build

Joinery manufactured in our workshop, fit-out executed by in-house trades — no handoffs, no diluted responsibility.

165+in-house workforce
05

Deliver

Snagging, deep clean and handover — documented, photographed and handed over ready to move in.

ISO9001 · 14001 · 45001
06

Aftercare

Post-handover support from the same team that built it — warranty follow-ups, adjustments and maintenance guidance.

12 mopost-handover support
